period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2014. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2015 (H1, Jan-Jun). SOLO basis, matching the main Q4/annual series. Starting with the half-year/quarter ended 30 June 2015, this bank's interim filings began including a genuine second 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' section (without the word 'Consolidated' in the heading) in addition to the Consolidated statements that appear earlier in the same document -- this Solo section is used here. Confirmed genuinely Solo (not a mislabeled repeat of the Consolidated figures) because: (a) its own figures are consistently smaller than the Consolidated section earlier in the same document, and (b) its prior-year-end comparator column reproduces this dataset's own independently-sourced annual Q4 Solo figure for that date exactly or to within rounding. From FY2021 onward the bank's own filings explicitly label this section 'Balance Sheet-Solo Basis' / 'Profit and Loss Account-Solo Basis' on their face. This filing is the FIRST in this bank's series to carry a genuine second (Solo) Balance Sheet/P&L in addition to the Consolidated statements earlier in the same document -- both this and comparator Total Assets (119,052,188,117) match this dataset's own independently-sourced FY2014 Q4 Solo annual figure exactly. Source is a scanned/image PDF; extracted via OCR (300dpi) of the dedicated Solo Balance Sheet and Solo Profit & Loss Account pages (distinct pages from the earlier Consolidated statements in the same document). EPS field was present but blank/illegible; not estimated (project policy: never fabricate a printed-but-illegible field beyond what can be derived transparently) -- omitted here since, unlike 2015 Q1, the source clearly intended to state a value but it did not survive extraction, and paid-up-capital/shares approach used for Q1 risks masking that this was a Solo not blended figure; left as a gap rather than guessed.
